ICS 93.080.20                         CED 05Revised Standard from Last Update.1 SCOPE1.1 This standard specifies requirements and test methods for solid un-reinforced precast cement concrete blocks and complementary blocks used for paving applications.1.2 The standard does not cover concrete masonry units, cellular (hollow) concrete blocks, fly ash masonry blocks, permeable concrete blocks, grid blocks, grass stones and cement concrete flooring tiles.2 REFERENCESThe standards listed in Annex A contain provisions, which through reference in this text, constitute provisions of this standard. At the time of publication, the editions indicated were valid. All standards are subject to revision, and parties to agreements based on this standard are encouraged to investigate the possibility of applying the most recent editions of the standards indicated in Annex A.
